Basic: a Content Page type with a title, an image and a description, its template, and a published welcome page; what a plain init gives you.

Create it

mkdir basic && cd basic
bunx @crombolo/cli@latest init --template basic
bun install

Start it

bun start

The site is served on http://localhost:8080/.

The first start applies the template's content and publishes it. The back office is at http://localhost:8080/crombolo, and the start prints how to sign in (Getting started).

What is in it

What a plain crombolo init gives you:

  • one content type, contentPage, with a title, an image and a description;
  • its template, components/contentPage.tsx;
  • one published page, the home page, welcoming you to Crombolo, as a content file in content/pages/;
  • the Crombolo logo, the home page's image, in content/media/.

Where to look first

Open components/contentPage.tsx and change what the page shows, then add types and pages from the command line: A site from the command line goes from here. crombolo init --empty starts with none of this.
